question: Should an empty QA Lab dashboard/API runner request intentionally switch from the prior live-flow-oriented defaults to the `smoke-ci` profile defaults?
rationale: The shared planning implementation can be tested mechanically, but selecting the default behavior for existing operator and API callers is a product and compatibility decision that source review cannot make safely.

options.title: Adopt the shared smoke profile default
options.body: Approve `smoke-ci` as the canonical empty-request contract so dashboard and CLI-style planning share profile-owned defaults.

options.title: Retain the legacy dashboard default
options.body: Keep the prior live-flow-oriented empty dashboard behavior and require an explicit profile selection to use `smoke-ci`.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared smoke profile default
recommendation.body: Approve `smoke-ci` as the canonical empty-request contract so dashboard and CLI-style planning share profile-owned defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: The submitted rationale explicitly owns and explains the proposed contract change for the QA Lab control plane.
